newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar Diamond delays Total closing.
newsitem.headline: Ultramar Diamond delays Total closing.

text.p: Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp said on Wednesday that it and Total Petroleum (North America) Ltd agreed not to close their merger until September 24, 1997, or an earlier date if the U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) terminates its investigation.
The FTC had previously asked for additional information about the proposed merger between the two companies.
"We will continue to cooperate with the FTC in its review of the transaction," Ultramar chairman and CEO Roger Hemminghaus said in a statement.
The company said it is confident that the deal will be completed, it cannot guarantee the outcome of a government investigation.
In the proposed transaction, which was approved by Total shareholders in June, each outstanding Total share would be converted into 0.322 of a share of Ultramar Diamond Shamrock common stock.
